title: Arbor
summary: Streaming subscriptions charge for time you never watch. Arbor sells prepaid viewing hours that only tick down while a film plays — filmmakers get paid per second watched, settled on-chain.
role: 3-person team · 7 days · Encode Club UXMaxx Hackathon

title: Lazy Builder
tagline: Figma-like canvas + Notion-like docs → real React code
summary: Design tools and code live in separate worlds, and translating between them loses information. Lazy Builder links an infinite canvas to a rich-text editor and exports a runnable React + Vite project.

title: Nutrify
tagline: Point a camera at food, get calories, macros, and a verdict
summary: Logging food by hand is why diet apps fail. Nutrify identifies a meal from a photo, estimates the portion, computes calories and macros, and says whether it fits your goal — cut, bulk, or maintain.

title: AILY
summary: Most store questions are routine, but answering them still takes staff. AILY parses natural-language messages and routes them to one of eleven handlers — search, cart, checkout, tracking — automatically.
